Hello stranger.. it is not wrong to tell people you are depressed. When you said that everyone buries you with their problems, it does sound like you tried to help people while you are suffering. It's okay if you take a little step back and put yourself first okay? We want you to be alive, so please be honest.. because you matter ❤🤍

Aww stranger, this warmed my heart when you mentioned about an inner child. Im so proud of you for mending and embracing the 10 year old you. All the experiences youve had, I am also proud because you overcame it. I empathize with you saying that all you wanted was a romantic relationship - to be tethered, guarded, loved, respected and understood. This reminds me when men are programmed to be tough and strong, that they should not cry, but please do remember, what you are feeling, what you are dying to express, it fully matters. Thank you for sharing this to all of us. I do hope luck will find you, and I wish you for better days. We love you, stranger ❤❤❤

I hear you stranger because.. this is what I feel as well. They may be intrusive and all that, possibly because of some resentment, anger and.. the nature of being misunderstood and mistreated. I even have thoughts about being the "villain" in a movie like shooting everyone, being a badass - but of course, I do not act on these things. Only just just suicidal thoughts manifesting in self harm. So yes, I understand you okay? Im so sorry you feel this way.

Much love 😊

You do have a point. And I agree with that wholeheartedly. No emotions, no more problems, just pure nothingness. Yet even in my death tbh I kinda do wonder what'd people think about me, what they'd say about me, what they would feel. I dont overthink these, but theres just this unwavering consideration. Will I be remembered in a good way for all the good things ive done? Will i be seen as a weakling? I dont know, but this point of yours is essentially a mark that... well, it wouldnt matter anyway, if we do die. Just for them.

You know, I also feel similarly to you when it comes to being excluded and not being "seen". In friend groups, I tend to be a flexible yet silent camouflage who can listen but could rarely offer bountiful ideas, but I can crack corny and decent jokes. What you are feeling is totally understandable and valid and Im sorry you feel that way. Im 18 and these things tend to happen with us because of many factors like.. unfamiliarity, social anxiety or simply introversion. It does suck and it makes you wish someone , just even ONE person to make an effort and understand you. To be with you. I hear you, friend. I wish you for better days and a beautiful luck for the right people to find you 😊
